_notes: SCOPE: these top-level keys describe sincere-hearth-273704.waterheater.waterheater_dict_new
(1751 rows), which is the dict table the non-NIQ QA harness is configured to write. Verified
2026-09-16 over all 1751 rows: 0 mismatches for both formulas below.
waterheater_dict_new has NO _meta column and NO 'type' column -- do not try to stamp or compose
either. Columns: brand, model, ajusted_model, system, sku_type_complete, keywords, keyword_typo.
brand is INITCAP-ed when composed into sku_type_complete but stored raw in the brand column
(e.g. brand 'KDK' -> sku_type_complete 'Kdk RG30AHM1'). 85 of 1751 rows differ this way.
keyword_typo is NULL on 1744 of 1751 rows (the old waterheater_dict used '' instead); it is the
one column allowed to be NULL. Its separator space is emitted even when it is NULL, so keywords
always starts with a single leading space.
ajusted_model is model with '-', '/', '(' and ')' each replaced by a single space (verified
2026-09-16: 1731/1758 rows match that rule vs 1685 for '-' and '/' alone; e.g. model
'TWH-45MCPMY(S)-WS' -> ajusted_model 'TWH 45MCPMY S  WS', the ')-' pair yielding two spaces).
'system' vocabulary in dict_new: 'Instan' 1329, 'Tank' 419, '' 3. NOTE this differs from the old
waterheater_dict ('Instan System'/'Tank System'), and in dict_new 'system' is NOT part of
sku_type_complete at all. Ground a new row's system on its own brand family's existing rows.
Load-bearing whitespace: many models carry leading/trailing spaces (' DH-3UDP1MZR', 'Pro80 ',
'JSH25 '), which leaks into sku_type_complete as double/trailing spaces. Preserve them in the
dict, but the QA table's own convention is the TRIMMED identity string (e.g. 'No Brand Water
Heater' 1218 rows vs 'No Brand Water Heater ' 476) -- trim when writing to the QA table.
LEGACY: sincere-hearth-273704.waterheater.waterheater_dict (1062 rows) is a different, older
table that DOES have a 'type' column (type = brand + ' ' + model; sku_type_complete = type +
' ' + system; keywords = keyword_typo + ' ' + type + ajusted_model). Do not apply this file's
formulas to it, and do not apply its formulas to dict_new.
